a1.say: Let's build Lists, Empty States and Conditions.

a1.cap: Render a task list: show a loading message while loading, each task with a ✓ when done, an empty-state message when there are no tasks, and a count of remaining tasks.

lines: Render a task list: show a loading message while loading, each task with a ✓ when done, an empty-state message when there are no tasks, and a count of remaining tasks.

a1.cap: Angular's built-in control flow replaces *ngIf and *ngFor. @for requires a track expression so Angular can reuse DOM nodes efficiently, and @empty handles the no-items case without an extra @if.
a1.say: Angular's built-in control flow replaces times ng If and times ng For. at for requires a track expression so Angular can reuse DOM nodes efficiently, and at empty handles the no-items case without an extra at if.

a1.cap: A typed Task interface keeps templates and code in sync.
@if with @else shows either the loading message or the list.
a1.say: at if with at else shows either the loading message or the list.

a1.cap: Tracking by id lets Angular move existing DOM rows instead of recreating them.
Class binding toggles the done CSS class per task.
@empty renders when the list has no items: a friendly empty state.
a1.say: at empty renders when the list has no items: a friendly empty state.

a1.cap: remaining is derived from tasks, so it's always correct.
